model.name: viewport.responsiveMode
model.description: R31.5.4 (viewport-mode, FOUNDATION) — RbStrip.applyViewportMode: container-query-driven landscape|portrait mode on the shared RbStrip (landscape=all-visible flex; portrait=horizontally-scrollable + scroll-snap on compartments, bars ride leading edge; focus-restore active-compartment on flip). Reuses the RbStrip class (shared w/ 5.2 strip.renderDescriptors), NOT a new component. Singular-chain. Architect topology (R31.5 5.4).
